role: Extension of AIAssistantSettingsPage (Settings → Flo) holding every section of its List: provider API-key rows, Apple on-device status, routing mode picker, web search (Tavily key + toggle), email-defaults pointer, remembered facts (UserFactsStore), language override, clipboard preservation, speech recognizer picker, provider kill switches, and disclosure.
types: AIAssistantSettingsPage: extension — section views and small actions
toplevel: No stored state; all members are computed views or methods using the page's @State (refreshToken, newFactText, showClearFactsConfirm, tavilyKeyDraft, tavilyKeyShown, tavilyKeySaveFailed) declared in AIAssistantSettingsPage.swift.

flags.text: Medical-guard status row says the guard 'Refuses AFib / arrhythmia / symptom queries before any provider call', while the Disclosure section on the same page says Emuqu 'points you to a clinician'; the two descriptions of the same guard differ.
No UI or unit test references AIAssistantSettingsPage; the Tavily save/remove flow and the web-search auto-disable are untested.
